correctness.rationale: A three-periodic Brian’s Brain site has exactly four possible full histories: silent or firing in one phase modulo 3; firing and refractory transitions force this. For 2-by-n periodic Moore neighbors with eight offset incidences counted separately, the explicit six-term local N_{r,t} rule is necessary/sufficient even at n>=3. Independent enumeration of the 16 column types, 256 ordered-pair transfer states and all 4096 triples gave 199 incident vertices and 346 directed edges. Every cyclic strongly connected component is exactly a single silent loop or one of two directed simple 12-cycles, each internal indegree/outdegree one; all other vertices are transient. A closed length-n walk exists only on those cycles, yielding #Fix(F_n^3)=1+24*[12|n] for all n>=3; the only temporal fixed point is silent, so primitive 3-cycles count (24/3)=8 when 12|n. Crucially the infinite-n conclusion is the finite transfer-graph decomposition, not testing just a finite set of n.
